result.title: Controlled-Minimax: Stabilizing Adversarial Optimization via Control Theory
result.summary: Minimax optimization is fundamental to adversarial learning yet suffers from severe stability challenges, often manifesting as persistent limit cycles or divergence. This paper investigates these instabilities through the lens of continuous-time dynamical systems. By modeling training dynamics as a second-order Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE), we rigorously identify the root cause of non-convergence: the problematic eigenstructure of the loss function's Hessian near equilibrium points. To address this, we introduce Controlled-Minimax, a novel stabilization framework that reformulates the optimization trajectory as a controllable physical system. Unlike heuristic regularization techniques, our approach derives a specific feedback controller that provides theoretical guarantees of local exponential stability, regardless of the underlying Hessian spectrum. Consequently, our method stabilizes general minimax problems where traditional gradient descent-ascent methods fail. Extensive experiments on pathological benchmarks including the Dirac-GAN, 2D Gaussian mixtures, and Swiss Roll datasets, as well as high-resolution image synthesis with StyleGAN2-ada, demonstrate that Controlled-Minimax effectively suppresses oscillatory behavior while ensuring fast and robust convergence.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把极小极大训练动力学建模为二阶 ODE，指出 Hessian 特征结构是极限环与发散的根源，并提出控制论式的反馈控制器来保证局部指数稳定，在 Dirac-GAN、2D 高斯混合、Swiss Roll 与 StyleGAN2-ada 上验证收敛与振荡抑制。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用反馈控制器稳定迭代优化动力学」的思路可能启发 loop/迭代式 latent 推理状态的振荡与收敛控制，但研究对象是 GAN 训练参数动力学而非推理状态内容，是否适用于 VLM 推理循环可供核查。
